bioconda.name: falcoamadeus
bioconda.summary: FalcoAmadeus: a faster, sequencing-aware fork of falco (a C++ FastQC alternative)
bioconda.description:
FalcoAmadeus is a performance-focused, sequencing-aware fork of falco (a fast
C++ reimplementation of FastQC). Default single-end output is byte-identical
to falco; opt-in features add correct paired-end analysis (one combined
report plus a corrected paired PCR-duplicate rate and R1/R2 pairing counts),
assay-aware pass/warn/fail grading, a redesigned interactive HTML report, and
multi-threaded gzip parsing. The fastqc_data.txt output is ingestible by
MultiQC.
